impact: Global risk appetite is holding up into CPI, which supports Monday's rebound in growth holdings unless inflation surprises high.
summary: Euro Stoxx 50 and DAX futures were about 0.9% higher early Tuesday after the Stoxx 600 closed up 1.26% at 656.52 on Monday and the DAX up 1.73%. Traders are focused on US CPI and the odds of a December Fed hike.
title: European futures up 0.9% after Stoxx 600 gains 1.3%, CPI eyed
